v.t: They ask you about the bounties. Say, “The bounties are for God and the Messenger.” So be mindful of God, and settle your differences, and obey God and His Messenger, if you are believers
v.l: Yas'alunaka `Ani Al-'Anfal Quli Al-'Anfali Lillahi Wa Ar-Rasuli Fa Attaqu Allaha Wa 'Aslihu Dhata Baynikum Wa 'Ati`u Allaha Wa Rasulahu 'In Kuntum Mu'uminina

v.t: The believers are those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, they strengthen them in faith, and upon their Lord they rely
v.l: Innama Al-Mu'uminuna Al-Ladhina 'Idha Dhukira Allahu Wajilat Qulubuhum Wa 'Idha Tuliyat `Alayhim 'Ayatuhu Zadat/hum 'Imanaan Wa `Ala Rabbihim Yatawakkaluna

v.t: Those who perform the prayer; and from Our provisions to them, they spend
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yuqimuna As-Salaata Wa Mimma Razaqnahum Yunfiquna

v.t: These are the true believers. They have high standing with their Lord, and forgiveness, and a generous provision
v.l: Ula'ika Humu Al-Mu'uminuna Haqqaan Lahum Darajatun `Inda Rabbihim Wa Maghfiratun Wa Rizqun Karimun

v.t: Even as your Lord brought you out of your home with the truth, some believers were reluctant
v.l: Kama 'Akhrajaka Rabbuka Min Baytika Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Inna Fariqaan Mina Al-Mu'uminina Lakarihuna

v.t: Arguing with you about the truth after it was made clear, as if they were being driven to death as they looked on
v.l: Yujadilunaka Fi Al-Haqqi Ba`dama Tabayyana Ka'annama Yusaquna 'Ila Al-Mawti Wa Hum Yanzuruna

v.t: God has promised you one of the two groups—that it would be yours—but you wanted the unarmed group to be yours. God intends to prove the truth with His words, and to uproot the disbelievers
v.l: Wa 'Idh Ya`idukumu Allahu 'Ihda At-Ta'ifatayni 'Annaha Lakum Wa Tawadduna 'Anna Ghayra Dhati Ash-Shawkati Takunu Lakum Wa Yuridu Allahu 'An Yuhiqqa Al-Haqqa Bikalimatihi Wa Yaqta`a Dabira Al-Kafirina

v.t: In order to confirm the truth and nullify falsehood, even though the guilty dislike it
v.l: Liyuhiqqa Al-Haqqa Wa Yubtila Al-Batila Wa Law Kariha Al-Mujrimuna

v.t: When you appealed to your Lord for help, He answered you, “I am reinforcing you with one thousand angels in succession.”
v.l: Idh Tastaghithuna Rabbakum Fastajaba Lakum 'Anni Mumiddukum Bi'alfin Mina Al-Mala'ikati Murdifina

v.t: God only made it a message of hope, and to set your hearts at rest. Victory comes only from God. God is Mighty and Wise
v.l: Wa Ma Ja`alahu Allahu 'Illa Bushra Wa Litatma'inna Bihi Qulubukum Wa Ma An-Nasru 'Illa Min `Indi Allahi 'Inna Allaha `Azizun Hakimun
w: and so that might be at rest

v.t: He made drowsiness overcome you, as a security from Him. And He sent down upon you water from the sky, to cleanse you with it, and to rid you of Satan’s pollution, and to fortify your hearts, and to strengthen your foothold
v.l: Idh Yughashikumu An-Nu`asa 'Amanatan Minhu Wa Yunazzilu `Alaykum Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Liyutahhirakum Bihi Wa Yudh/hiba `Ankum Rijza Ash-Shaytani Wa Liyarbita `Ala Qulubikum Wa Yuthabbita Bihi Al-'Aqdama
w: so that He may purify you

v.t: Your Lord inspired the angels: “I am with you, so support those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike above the necks, and strike off every fingertip of theirs.”
v.l: Idh Yuhi Rabbuka 'Ila Al-Mala'ikati 'Anni Ma`akum Fathabbitu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Sa'ulqi Fi Qulubi Al-Ladhina Kafaru Ar-Ru`ba Fađribu Fawqa Al-'A`naqi Wa Ađribu Minhum Kulla Bananin

v.t: That is because they opposed God and His Messenger. Whoever opposes God and His Messenger—God is severe in retribution
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahum Shaqqu Allaha Wa Rasulahu Wa Man Yushaqiqi Allaha Wa Rasulahu Fa'inna Allaha Shadidu Al-`Iqabi

v.t: “Here it is; so taste it.” For the disbelievers there is the suffering of the Fire
v.l: Dhalikum Fadhuquhu Wa 'Anna Lilkafirina `Adhaba An-Nari

v.t: O you who believe! When you meet those who disbelieve on the march, never turn your backs on them
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Idha Laqitumu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Zahfaan Fala Tuwalluhumu Al-'Adbara

v.t: Anyone who turns his back on them on that Day, except while maneuvering for battle, or to join another group, has incurred wrath from God, and his abode is Hell—what a miserable destination
v.l: Wa Man Yuwallihim Yawma'idhin Duburahu 'Illa Mutaharrifaan Liqitalin 'Aw Mutahayyizaan 'Ila Fi'atin Faqad Ba'a Bighađabin Mina Allahi Wa Ma'wahu Jahannamu Wa Bi'sa Al-Masiru

v.t: It was not you who killed them, but it was God who killed them. And it was not you who launched when you launched, but it was God who launched. That He may bestow upon the believers an excellent reward. God is Hearing and Knowing
v.l: Falam Taqtuluhum Wa Lakinna Allaha Qatalahum Wa Ma Ramayta 'Idh Ramayta Wa Lakinna Allaha Rama Wa Liyubliya Al-Mu'uminina Minhu Bala'an Hasanaan 'Inna Allaha Sami`un `Alimun

v.t: Such is the case. God will undermine the strategy of the disbelievers
v.l: Dhalikum Wa 'Anna Allaha Muhinu Kaydi Al-Kafirina

v.t: If you desire a verdict, the verdict has come to you. And if you desist, it would be best for you. And if you return, We will return; and your troops, however numerous, will not benefit you. God is with the believers
v.l: In Tastaftihu Faqad Ja'akumu Al-Fathu Wa 'In Tantahu Fahuwa Khayrun Lakum Wa 'In Ta`udu Na`ud Wa Lan Tughniya `Ankum Fi'atukum Shay'aan Wa Law Kathurat Wa 'Anna Allaha Ma`a Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: O you who believe! Obey God and His Messenger, and do not turn away from him when you hear
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Ati`u Allaha Wa Rasulahu Wa La Tawallaw `Anhu Wa 'Antum Tasma`una

v.t: And be not like those who say, “We hear,” when they do not hear
v.l: Wa La Takunu Kalladhina Qalu Sami`na Wa Hum La Yasma`una

v.t: The worst of animals to God are the deaf and dumb—those who do not reason
v.l: Inna Sharra Ad-Dawabbi `Inda Allahi As-Summu Al-Bukmu Al-Ladhina La Ya`qiluna

v.t: Had God recognized any good in them, He would have made them hear; and had He made them hear, they would have turned away defiantly
v.l: Wa Law `Alima Allahu Fihim Khayraan La'asma`ahum Wa Law 'Asma`ahum Latawallaw Wa Hum Mu`riđuna
w: surely, He (would) have made them hear
surely they would have turned away

v.t: O you who believe! Respond to God and to the Messenger when He calls you to what will revive you. And know that God stands between a man and his heart, and that to Him you will be gathered
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Astajibu Lillahi Wa Lilrrasuli 'Idha Da`akum Lima Yuhyikum Wa A`lamu 'Anna Allaha Yahulu Bayna Al-Mar'i Wa Qalbihi Wa 'Annahu 'Ilayhi Tuhsharuna

v.t: And beware of discord which does not afflict the wrongdoers among you exclusively; and know that God is severe in retribution
v.l: Wa Attaqu Fitnatan La Tusibanna Al-Ladhina Zalamu Minkum Khassatan Wa A`lamu 'Anna Allaha Shadidu Al-`Iqabi

v.t: And remember when you were few, oppressed in the land, fearing that people may capture you; but He sheltered you, and supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things—so that you may be thankful
v.l: Wa Adhkuru 'Idh 'Antum Qalilun Mustađ`afuna Fi Al-'Arđi Takhafuna 'An Yatakhattafakumu An-Nasu Fa'awakum Wa 'Ayyadakum Binasrihi Wa Razaqakum Mina At-Tayyibati La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: O you who believe! Do not betray God and the Messenger, nor betray your trusts, while you know
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu La Takhunu Allaha Wa Ar-Rasula Wa Takhunu 'Amanatikum Wa 'Antum Ta`lamuna

v.t: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that God possesses an immense reward
v.l: Wa A`lamu 'Annama 'Amwalukum Wa 'Awladukum Fitnatun Wa 'Anna Allaha `Indahu 'Ajrun `Azimun

v.t: O you who believe! If you remain conscious of God, He will give you a criterion, and will remit from you your sins, and will forgive you. God is possessor of infinite grace
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'In Tattaqu Allaha Yaj`al Lakum Furqanaan Wa Yukaffir `Ankum Sayyi'atikum Wa Yaghfir Lakum Wa Allahu Dhu Al-Fađli Al-`Azimi

v.t: When the disbelievers plotted against you, to imprison you, or kill you, or expel you. They planned, and God planned, but God is the Best of planners
v.l: Wa 'Idh Yamkuru Bika Al-Ladhina Kafaru Liyuthbituka 'Aw Yaqtuluka 'Aw Yukhrijuka Wa Yamkuruna Wa Yamkuru Allahu Wa Allahu Khayru Al-Makirina

v.t: And when Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “We have heard. Had we wanted, we could have said the like of this; these are nothing but myths of the ancients.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatuna Qalu Qad Sami`na Law Nasha'u Laqulna Mithla Hadha 'In Hadha 'Illa 'Asatiru Al-'Awwalina

v.t: And they said, “Our God, if this is the truth from You, then rain down on us stones from the sky, or visit us with a painful affliction.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qalu Al-Lahumma 'In Kana Hadha Huwa Al-Haqqa Min `Indika Fa'amtir `Alayna Hijaratan Mina As-Sama'i 'Aw A'tina Bi`adhabin 'Alimin

v.t: But God would not punish them while you are amongst them. And God would not punish them as long as they seek forgiveness
v.l: Wa Ma Kana Allahu Liyu`adhibahum Wa 'Anta Fihim Wa Ma Kana Allahu Mu`adhibahum Wa Hum Yastaghfiruna

v.t: Yet why should God not punish them, when they are turning others away from the Sacred Mosque, although they are not its custodians? Its rightful custodians are the pious; but most of them do not know
v.l: Wa Ma Lahum 'Alla Yu`adhibahumu Allahu Wa Hum Yasudduna `Ani Al-Masjidi Al-Harami Wa Ma Kanu 'Awliya'ahu 'In 'Awliya'uuhu 'Illa Al-Muttaquna Wa Lakinna 'Aktharahum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and clapping—so taste the punishment for your blasphemy
v.l: Wa Ma Kana Salatuhum `Inda Al-Bayti 'Illa Muka'an Wa Tasdiyatan Fadhuqu Al-`Adhaba Bima Kuntum Takfuruna

v.t: Those who disbelieve spend their wealth to repel from God’s path. They will spend it, then it will become a source of sorrow for them, and then they will be defeated. Those who disbelieve will be herded into Hell
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Yunfiquna 'Amwalahum Liyasuddu `An Sabili Allahi Fasayunfiqunaha Thumma Takunu `Alayhim Hasratan Thumma Yughlabuna Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Ila Jahannama Yuhsharuna

v.t: That God may distinguish the bad from the good, and heap the bad on top of one another, and pile them together, and throw them in Hell. These are the losers
v.l: Liyamiza Allahu Al-Khabitha Mina At-Tayyibi Wa Yaj`ala Al-Khabitha Ba`đahu `Ala Ba`đin Fayarkumahu Jami`aan Fayaj`alahu Fi Jahannama 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Khasiruna

v.t: Say to those who disbelieve: if they desist, their past will be forgiven. But if they persist—the practice of the ancients has passed away
v.l: Qul Lilladhina Kafaru 'In Yantahu Yughfar Lahum Ma Qad Salafa Wa 'In Ya`udu Faqad Mađat Sunnatu Al-'Awwalina

v.t: Fight them until there is no more persecution, and religion becomes exclusively for God. But if they desist—God is Seeing of what they do
v.l: Wa Qatiluhum Hatta La Takuna Fitnatun Wa Yakuna Ad-Dinu Kulluhu Lillahi Fa'ini Antahaw Fa'inna Allaha Bima Ya`maluna Basirun

v.t: And if they turn away, know that God is your Protector. The Best Protector, and the Best Supporter
v.l: Wa 'In Tawallaw Fa`lamu 'Anna Allaha Mawlakum Ni`ma Al-Mawla Wa Ni`ma An-Nasiru

v.t: And know that whatever spoils you gain, to God belongs its fifth, and to the Messenger, and the relatives, and the orphans, and the poor, and to the wayfarer, provided you believe in God and in what We revealed to Our servant on the Day of Distinction, the day when the two armies met. God is Capable of everything
v.l: Wa A`lamu 'Annama Ghanimtum Min Shay'in Fa'anna Lillahi Khumusahu Wa Lilrrasuli Wa Lidhi Al-Qurba Wa Al-Yatama Wa Al-Masakini Wa Abni As-Sabili 'In Kuntum 'Amantum Billahi Wa Ma 'Anzalna `Ala `Abdina Yawma Al-Furqani Yawma At-Taqa Al-Jam`ani Wa Allahu `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: Recall when you were on the nearer bank, and they were on the further bank, and the caravan was below you. Had you planned for this meeting, you would have disagreed on the timing, but God was to carry out a predetermined matter, so that those who perish would perish by clear evidence, and those who survive would survive by clear evidence. God is Hearing and Knowing
v.l: Idh 'Antum Bil-`Udwati Ad-Dunya Wa Hum Bil-`Udwati Al-Quswa Wa Ar-Rakbu 'Asfala Minkum Wa Law Tawa`adttum Lakhtalaftum Fi Al-Mi`adi Wa Lakin Liyaqđiya Allahu 'Amraan Kana Maf`ulaan Liyahlika Man Halaka `An Bayyinatin Wa Yahya Man Hayya `An Bayyinatin Wa 'Inna Allaha Lasami`un `Alimun

v.t: God made them appear in your dream as few. Had He made them appear as many, you would have lost heart, and disputed in the matter. But God saved the situation. He knows what the hearts contain
v.l: Idh Yurikahumu Allahu Fi Manamika Qalilaan Wa Law 'Arakahum Kathiraan Lafashiltum Wa Latanaza`tum Fi Al-'Amri Wa Lakinna Allaha Sallama 'Innahu `Alimun Bidhati As-Suduri
w: He had shown them to you
surely you would have lost courage
and surely you would have disputed

v.t: When you met, He made them appear as few in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes, so that God may conclude a predetermined matter. To God all matters revert
v.l: Wa 'Idh Yurikumuhum 'Idhi At-Taqaytum Fi 'A`yunikum Qalilaan Wa Yuqallilukum Fi 'A`yunihim Liyaqđiya Allahu 'Amraan Kana Maf`ulaan Wa 'Ila Allahi Turja`u Al-'Umuru
w: and He made you (appear) as few

v.t: O you who believe! When you meet a force, stand firm, and remember God much, so that you may prevail
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Idha Laqitum Fi'atan Fathbutu Wa Adhkuru Allaha Kathiraan La`allakum Tuflihuna

v.t: And obey God and His Messenger, and do not dispute, lest you falter and lose your courage. And be steadfast. God is with the steadfast
v.l: Wa 'Ati`u Allaha Wa Rasulahu Wa La Tanaza`u Fatafshalu Wa Tadh/haba Rihukum Wa Asbiru 'Inna Allaha Ma`a As-Sabirina

v.t: And do not be like those who left their homes boastfully, showing off before the people, and barring others from the path of God. God comprehends what they do
v.l: Wa La Takunu Kalladhina Kharaju Min Diyarihim Bataraan Wa Ri'a'a An-Nasi Wa Yasudduna `An Sabili Allahi Wa Allahu Bima Ya`maluna Muhitun

v.t: Satan made their deeds appear good to them, and said, “You cannot be defeated by any people today, and I am at your side.” But when the two armies came in sight of one another, he turned on his heels, and said, “I am innocent of you; I see what you do not see; I fear God; God is severe in punishment.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Zayyana Lahumu Ash-Shaytanu 'A`malahum Wa Qala La Ghaliba Lakumu Al-Yawma Mina An-Nasi Wa 'Inni Jarun Lakum Falamma Tara'ati Al-Fi'atani Nakasa `Ala `Aqibayhi Wa Qala 'Inni Bari'un Minkum 'Inni 'Ara Ma La Tarawna 'Inniyi 'Akhafu Allaha Wa Allahu Shadidu Al-`Iqabi

v.t: The hypocrites and those in whose hearts is sickness said, “Their religion has deluded these people.” But whoever puts his trust in God—God is Mighty and Wise
v.l: Idh Yaqulu Al-Munafiquna Wa Al-Ladhina Fi Qulubihim Marađun Gharra Ha'uula' Dinuhum Wa Man Yatawakkal `Ala Allahi Fa'inna Allaha `Azizun Hakimun

v.t: If only you could see, as the angels take away those who disbelieve, striking their faces and their backs: “Taste the agony of the Burning.”
v.l: Wa Law Tara 'Idh Yatawaffa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Al-Mala'ikatu Yađribuna Wujuhahum Wa 'Adbarahum Wa Dhuqu `Adhaba Al-Hariqi

v.t: “That is because of what your hands have committed, and because God is not unjust to the servants.”
v.l: Dhalika Bima Qaddamat 'Aydikum Wa 'Anna Allaha Laysa Bizallamin Lil`abidi

v.t: Like the behavior of the people of Pharaoh, and those before them. They rejected the signs of God, so God seized them for their sins. God is Powerful, Severe in punishment
v.l: Kada'bi 'Ali Fir`awna Wa Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Kafaru Bi'ayati Allahi Fa'akhadhahumu Allahu Bidhunubihim 'Inna Allaha Qawiyun Shadidu Al-`Iqabi

v.t: That is because God would never change a blessing He has bestowed on a people unless they change what is within themselves, and because God is Hearing and Knowing
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Lam Yaku Mughayyiraan Ni`matan 'An`amaha `Ala Qawmin Hatta Yughayyiru Ma Bi'anfusihim Wa 'Anna Allaha Sami`un `Alimun

v.t: Such was the case with the people of Pharaoh, and those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We annihilated them for their wrongs, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh—they were all evildoers
v.l: Kada'bi 'Ali Fir`awna Wa Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Kadhabu Bi'ayati Rabbihim Fa'ahlaknahum Bidhunubihim Wa 'Aghraqna 'Ala Fir`awna Wa Kullun Kanu Zalimina

v.t: The worst of creatures in God's view are those who disbelieve. They have no faith
v.l: Inna Sharra Ad-Dawabbi `Inda Allahi Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fahum La Yu'uminuna

v.t: Those of them with whom you made a treaty, but they violate their agreement every time. They are not righteous
v.l: Al-Ladhina `Ahadta Minhum Thumma Yanquđuna `Ahdahum Fi Kulli Marratin Wa Hum La Yattaquna

v.t: If you confront them in battle, make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them, that they may take heed
v.l: Fa'imma Tathqafannahum Fi Al-Harbi Fasharrid Bihim Man Khalfahum La`allahum Yadhakkaruna

v.t: If you fear treachery on the part of a people, break off with them in a like manner. God does not like the treacherous
v.l: Wa 'Imma Takhafanna Min Qawmin Khiyanatan Fanbidh 'Ilayhim `Ala Sawa'in 'Inna Allaha La Yuhibbu Al-Kha'inina

v.t: Let not the disbelievers assume that they are ahead. They will not escape
v.l: Wa La Yahsabanna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Sabaqu 'Innahum La Yu`jizuna

v.t: And prepare against them all the power you can muster, and all the cavalry you can mobilize, to terrify thereby God’s enemies and your enemies, and others besides them whom you do not know, but God knows them. Whatever you spend in God’s way will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged
v.l: Wa 'A`iddu Lahum Ma Astata`tum Min Quwatin Wa Min Ribati Al-Khayli Turhibuna Bihi `Aduwa Allahi Wa `Aduwakum Wa 'Akharina Min Dunihim La Ta`lamunahumu Allahu Ya`lamuhum Wa Ma Tunfiqu Min Shay'in Fi Sabili Allahi Yuwaffa 'Ilaykum Wa 'Antum La Tuzlamuna

v.t: But if they incline towards peace, then incline towards it, and put your trust in God. He is the Hearer, the Knower
v.l: Wa 'In Janahu Lilssalmi Fajnah Laha Wa Tawakkal `Ala Allahi 'Innahu Huwa As-Sami`u Al-`Alimu

v.t: If they intend to deceive you—God is sufficient for you. It is He who supported you with His aid, and with the believers
v.l: Wa 'In Yuridu 'An Yakhda`uka Fa'inna Hasbaka Allahu Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Ayyadaka Binasrihi Wa Bil-Mu'uminina

v.t: And He united their hearts. Had you spent everything on earth, you would not have united their hearts, but God united them together. He is Mighty and Wise
v.l: Wa 'Allafa Bayna Qulubihim Law 'Anfaqta Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Jami`aan Ma 'Allafta Bayna Qulubihim Wa Lakinna Allaha 'Allafa Baynahum 'Innahu `Azizun Hakimun

v.t: O prophet! Count on God, and on the believers who have followed you
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nabiyu Hasbuka Allahu Wa Mani Attaba`aka Mina Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: O prophet! Rouse the believers to battle. If there are twenty steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a hundred of you, they will defeat a thousand of those who disbelieve; because they are a people who do not understand
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nabiyu Harriđi Al-Mu'uminina `Ala Al-Qitali 'In Yakun Minkum `Ishruna Sabiruna Yaghlibu Mia'atayni Wa 'In Yakun Minkum Mia'atun Yaghlibu 'Alfaan Mina Al-Ladhina Kafaru Bi'annahum Qawmun La Yafqahuna

v.t: God has now lightened your burden, knowing that there is weakness in you. If there are a hundred steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a thousand of you, they will defeat two thousand by God’s leave. God is with the steadfast
v.l: Al-'Ana Khaffafa Allahu `Ankum Wa `Alima 'Anna Fikum Đa`faan Fa'in Yakun Minkum Mia'atun Sabiratun Yaghlibu Mia'atayni Wa 'In Yakun Minkum 'Alfun Yaghlibu 'Alfayni Bi'idhni Allahi Wa Allahu Ma`a As-Sabirina

v.t: It is not for a prophet to take prisoners before he has subdued the land. You desire the materials of this world, but God desires the Hereafter. God is Strong and Wise
v.l: Ma Kana Linabiyin 'An Yakuna Lahu 'Asra Hatta Yuthkhina Fi Al-'Arđi Turiduna `Arađa Ad-Dunya Wa Allahu Yuridu Al-'Akhirata Wa Allahu `Azizun Hakimun

v.t: Were it not for a predetermined decree from God, an awful punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken
v.l: Lawla Kitabun Mina Allahi Sabaqa Lamassakum Fima 'Akhadhtum `Adhabun `Azimun

v.t: So consume what you have gained, legitimate and wholesome; and remain conscious of God. God is Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Fakulu Mimma Ghanimtum Halalaan Tayyibaan Wa Attaqu Allaha 'Inna Allaha Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: O prophet! Say to those you hold prisoners, “If God finds any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nabiyu Qul Liman Fi 'Aydikum Mina Al-'Asra 'In Ya`lami Allahu Fi Qulubikum Khayraan Yu'utikum Khayraan Mimma 'Ukhidha Minkum Wa Yaghfir Lakum Wa Allahu Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: But if they intend to betray you, they have already betrayed God, and He has overpowered them. God is Knowing and Wise
v.l: Wa 'In Yuridu Khiyanataka Faqad Khanu Allaha Min Qablu Fa'amkana Minhum Wa Allahu `Alimun Hakimun

v.t: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled in God’s cause with their possessions and their persons, and those who provided shelter and support—these are allies of one another. As for those who believed, but did not emigrate, you owe them no protection, until they have emigrated. But if they ask you for help in religion, you must come to their aid, except against a people with whom you have a treaty. God is Seeing of what you do
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Hajaru Wa Jahadu Bi'amwalihim Wa 'Anfusihim Fi Sabili Allahi Wa Al-Ladhina 'Awaw Wa Nasaru 'Ula'ika Ba`đuhum 'Awliya'u Ba`đin Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Lam Yuhajaru Ma Lakum Min Walayatihim Min Shay'in Hatta Yuhajiru Wa 'Ini Astansarukum Fi Ad-Dini Fa`alaykumu An-Nasru 'Illa `Ala Qawmin Baynakum Wa Baynahum Mithaqun Wa Allahu Bima Ta`maluna Basirun

v.t: As for those who disbelieve, they are allies of one another. Unless you do this, there will be turmoil in the land, and much corruption
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Ba`đuhum 'Awliya'u Ba`đin 'Illa Taf`aluhu Takun Fitnatun Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Fasadun Kabirun

v.t: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled for God’s cause, and those who gave shelter and support—these are the true believers. They will have forgiveness, and a bountiful provision
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Hajaru Wa Jahadu Fi Sabili Allahi Wa Al-Ladhina 'Awaw Wa Nasaru 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Mu'uminuna Haqqaan Lahum Maghfiratun Wa Rizqun Karimun

v.t: As for those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and struggled with you—these belong with you. But family members are nearer to one another in the Book of God. God is Cognizant of everything
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Min Ba`du Wa Hajaru Wa Jahadu Ma`akum Fa'ula'ika Minkum Wa 'Ulu Al-'Arhami Ba`đuhum 'Awla Biba`đin Fi Kitabi Allahi 'Inna Allaha Bikulli Shay'in `Alimun
